title: Charming 2BR Private Cottage on 30A with Beach Access
meta_description: Relax at Bijou By The Sea, a 2BR, 2BA private home on 30A with beach access, a claw-foot bathtub, oversized shower, and a covered porch. Sleeps 4.
description_expanded: Bijou Definition (Bee/Zhoo): Especially of a residence or business establishment. Small and elegant. "A bijou residence"Bijou By The Sea exudes a spirit of simpler times. Tucked away, 2 blocks off 30A in Old Seagrove, Bijou By The Sea offers tranquility and privacy in an idyllic setting. Bijou is close to Seagrove's bustling mix of boutiques, casual cafes and upbeat ambiance. Plus, it's a beautiful, quick 5-minute walk to the beach, not to mention a short bike ride from Seaside!Don't let the size fool you! Bijou is packed with everything you need. This charming upscale cottage has 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths. The 1st bedroom has a queen bed and private bathroom with a beautiful porcelain claw foot tub. The 2nd bedroom has a full bed and an attached bathroom with oversized shower. The fully stocked kitchen features a gas range plus a large island that opens into the comfortable and charming coastal style living room. Take advantage of grocery delivery from the Publix grocery store at WaterColor!Bijou’s backyard includes an expansive paver patio, paver walkways & dining table offering a picturesque coastal casual Al fresco dining experience. A pergola offers an additional private area to relax. Bijou’s screened in back porch & covered front porch complete this beach cottage retreat.Enjoy year-round access to two complimentary bikes provided by Butterfly Bikes. They're always available, making it easy and fun to explore your surroundings whenever you want.Enjoy the ultimate convenience - just a short walk or bike ride away, you'll find beach parking, public beach access, and the Gulf of Mexico awaiting your arrival! No need to worry about private beach restrictions here - public beach access promises endless days of seaside splendor. 30A offers miles of biking paths and hiking trails plus kayaking and paddle boarding on its beautiful coastal dune lakes.Your stay at Bijou by the Sea comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars.* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Bikes provided year round.* Fireplace is decorative only and not operational.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
